scene_prompt: Create a 3D find-and-explore map set in a colorful cartoon pizza-themed world with playful oversized food scenery. A central hub opens into three distinct explorable areas branching outward, all accessible from the start. Place varied cool-looking pizza props throughout the hub and each area so they stand out clearly among the food-themed environments.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Adventure: players explore a world to find distributed pizza items. There is no secondary genre.

### Shape and preset
Use `world-open`, matching the Scavenger Hunt preset. Keep its open exploration character, but organize the single map around a central hub and three immediately available branches rather than a dispersed free-roam field.

### Config requirements
Use `collectible-nodes` as invisible layout placements: varied, clearly readable pizza finds are distributed through every area, tucked into distinctive food scenery rather than rendered as generic markers. No other gameplay options are required. The central hub and the three branches are visible geometry, not separate maps or locked progression.

### Layout components
Build one contiguous, medium-sized exterior world. A broad circular central hub occupies the middle of the plan, with colorful pizza-themed paving and oversized cartoon food props that establish the setting. Three distinct explorable areas radiate outward from the hub at roughly even angles, each reached by a broad, unobstructed path and all open from the start.

Give each branch a visibly different food-playground identity while retaining the shared bright cartoon palette: one can be a towering cheesy pizza plaza, one a playful pepperoni-and-sauce garden, and one an oversized bakery or snack-landscape zone. Each branch should be large enough for a short looping exploration route with pockets, overlooks, and prop clusters that make individual pizza finds stand out. Place pizza props throughout the hub and all three areas, including obvious showcase positions and a few visually sheltered corners. Use giant cheese wedges, sauce pools, breadstick rails, mushroom-like toppings, and food-shaped rocks as scenery. Keep the outer boundary natural and playful, using oversized food cliffs, dense prop walls, or distant backdrop scenery rather than hard walls. Frame the hub centrally with all three colorful branches legible around it.

### Render order
Use `topdown`: the hub must connect cleanly to all three accessible exploration areas so every pizza-placement region remains reachable.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium, driven by one hub plus three distinct exploration branches. Theme: colorful cartoon pizza world, oversized whimsical food scenery, high-contrast collectible props. Use `P0`; this is one connected exterior surface with no forced multi-map, interior, overhang, or validity-construction cost.
